claims.claim: Bought as brand new working perfectly well
claims.evidence: Photos show appearance only; purchase as new and working condition are not shown.

claims.claim: Barely used, bought new last year
claims.evidence: Age and usage history are not shown in the report.
Whether the fan powers on and internal condition are not shown.
The motor interior cannot be seen in the exterior photos.
No photo of a receipt or warranty card is in the witness report.

risks.risk: The fan does not power on or run.
risks.proof: Video clip of the fan being switched on and running through its speed settings.

risks.risk: The motor or internal wiring is faulty or has been opened or repaired.
risks.proof: Close-up video of the motor running smoothly and a photo of the motor housing and seals.

risks.risk: Height adjustment or oscillation functions do not work.
risks.proof: Clip demonstrating the stand height adjustment and oscillation in operation.

risks.risk: Hidden cracks or damage on blades, cage, or stand.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of each wooden blade, the cage joints, and the stand and base.

risks.risk: Age and usage are greater than claimed.
risks.proof: Photo of the original receipt showing the purchase date.

proof_requests: Video of the fan switched on and running at all speeds
Clip showing height adjustment and oscillation
Close-up photos of blades, cage, stand, and motor housing
Photo of the receipt and warranty card
response.reason: The witness identifies the item as a standing fan, so it can be priced at its worst case; the seller's condition and age claims are not proven by the photos.
